title: Automation Technician — Career Roadmap
summary: An Automation Technician installs, operates, tests and maintains automated machinery and control systems using sensors, actuators, PLCs, industrial robots and monitoring software. The role helps factories improve productivity, consistency and operational safety.

blocks.label: Recommended route
blocks.text: Class 10 followed by a relevant engineering diploma; a Science stream with Mathematics is also useful.

blocks.label: Important subjects
blocks.text: Mathematics, Physics, basic electronics, electrical systems and Computer Applications.

blocks.label: Entrance exams
blocks.text: State polytechnic admission tests, such as AP POLYCET for applicable Andhra Pradesh admissions; verify current notifications.

blocks.label: Explore
blocks.text: Industrial robots, sensors, control panels, PLCs, motors and automated production lines.

blocks.label: Early skills
blocks.text: Logical reasoning, technical drawing, troubleshooting, basic programming and workshop safety.

items.text: Diploma in Mechatronics Engineering → Integrated mechanical, electrical and automation systems.
Diploma in Instrumentation & Control Engineering → Sensors, transmitters, process control and calibration.
Diploma in Robotics → Robot operation, programming fundamentals and automated manufacturing.
Diploma in Electrical Engineering → Motors, drives, control panels and industrial maintenance.
Diploma in Electronics Engineering → PLC interfaces, sensors, control electronics and troubleshooting.

blocks.label: Direct preparation
blocks.text: Prioritise programmes with practical PLC, motor-drive, sensor, pneumatic and industrial-control laboratories.
